steps.name: Mannered Server
steps.text: Welcome to Ding Feng Lou.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wow... So this is the place everyone's talking about.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Are you... nervous?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? Don't think I should be.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: The competition is nigh, and yet, I feel... apprehensive, somehow...

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I mean...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nothing to fear! The Young Chef said it was fine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Besides, it's not like we're trying to be cooks here. We're just on the hunt for that legendary chef, right? To ask him for his tangerine cake recipe.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Cold comfort, but I suppose at this point that's all I'm getting...

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: It's about time. All spectators please remain here for now. Competitors, follow me.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: If you get anything difficult thrown at you, don't bluster, just keep calm and think. There's always a way...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Relax, okay? I'll see you.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Please, sit.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: While I know you're here for the exam, you're still one of our guests. Please, let me offer you some tea first.
The examiner picks up the teapot from the table and pours Blaze some tea. Her nose is immediately filled with the fresh, sweet scent.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: For a competition, you're all being pretty friendly here...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, can't say I haven't been thirsty. Thanks!
Blaze grabs the teacup and drinks it up.
As she does, the examiner places a pen and paper before her.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: This pot of tea is infused with several ingredients. Please write them down.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: PFFTH—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *hack*... What?!
Blaze glances down at her cup, naught but a bead of tea left on the side. She looks up at the examiner, polite smile still plastered over his face.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Could I, uh... have another cup?

steps.name: Laidback Chef
steps.text: Today looks like a bust to me. They've gone through dozens of people since morning, and nobody's even passed the first stage.

steps.name: Bored Chef
steps.text: Our head chef is being too harsh on them. It's like a revolving door over there—No one can last longer than a minute.

steps.name: Laidback Chef
steps.text: A chef's third eye is their tongue. If their tongue's not good enough, they can't be that good a chef.

steps.name: Laidback Chef
steps.text: So, no point wasting the head chef's time if they can't even pass stage one. May as well send 'em home sooner.

steps.name: Laidback Chef
steps.text: Hey, hey, 'scuse me, madam, this is the kitchen. Are you—

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Judicial Review Office investigation. If I could have both your assistance.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Keep calm... keep calm...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What did Mechanist tell you? The human tongue can only taste four flavors, but the nose can tell between over a hundred...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Not that I ever smelt anything from his 'Machine Oil' moonshine, though...
Blaze gingerly cradles her cooling teacup once more, and takes a careful sniff of what aroma remains.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Smells flowery. That's probably jasmine...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No, not just jasmine, there's a kind of... right, chrysanthemum! Just like the table tea at the Young Chef's place!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, aside from that, there was definitely a sweet-sour kind of flavor as I drank it...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: None of the initial flavors were sour, so what was that aftertaste...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sweet, acid, and a little puckery... kind of familiar?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why'd you want me to try this plum wine, anyway?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: It's a specialty here in Baizao, you see.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: There's a plum forest north of the city. When summer sets in June and the plums are fresh and ripe, the people pick them to steep in wine—ideally a Xiaohan wine.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Mmm... wine made from mossoats like this just has a particular flavor to it. It goes perfect with plum.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Steep it for about three months, and it's ready just in time for Mid-Autumn.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Plum wine, huh... So it's got history?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Earlier, you asked me what happened to all the people we lost building Baizao, right?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: I wouldn't say it's got history, really. It just strikes me... during those awful times back then, pickled plums were a worker's staple.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: And some years after finishing Baizao, that plum forest sprang up in the mountains north of us. No one knows exactly when it did, nor who planted it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So it's a way of... remembering them, kind of?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: At least they were never forgotten.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Once the plums are ripe next year, we can go to the mountains to see together.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Here's my answer.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Jasmine, chrysanthemum, green plum, Mount T'ien blossom, rock sugar... Xiaohan wine?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've heard there's a plum forest north of Baizao.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The plums in June get brewed for Mid-Autumn. I'm guessing the plums in this were picked earlier than that, which is why there's still a mouth-puckering taste in it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The alcohol steamed away while boiling the tea, and left just the sweet-sourness of the plum. Plus the mild and subtle aroma from the flower...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It wasn't obvious when I drank it down, but the aftertaste really stays with you... I'd really like another cup!

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Identifying the first few flavors is reasonable enough, but you're the first one today who's been able to point out the use of Xiaohan wine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So... I'm right?

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Are you not sure about your own answer?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No! No, of course not! Of course I don't... Haha...

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Then congratulations on passing the first stage.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Please, follow me upstairs.
From the rear hall sounds a gong, and the doors next to Blaze yawn open.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: First stage...? How long is this thing...?

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: Here you are, madam. The list of chefs at Ding Feng Lou.

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: If you don't mind me asking, what are you investigating exactly...?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: ...The case is confidential. I'm not at leisure to tell you for now.

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: The head chef here, their name is Mo Bufu?

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: Yes. I don't think there's a cook in Baizao who doesn't know of Chef Mo.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Do you know what his occupation was prior to Ding Feng Lou?

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: That, I have no idea. Chef Mo arrived... just under ten years ago? Not quite a long time, but not short either. His cooking skills are the real deal, they're sublime. Almost straight away, he succeeded the previous head chef.

spans.text: That, I have no idea. Chef Mo arrived... just under ten years ago? Not quite a long time, but not short either. His cooking skills are the real deal, they're
. Almost straight away, he succeeded the previous head chef.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Where is he now? I need to see him.

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: I'm really sorry, but he's holding an exam right this moment. There's no way he can meet you.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Exam? What exam?

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: You could call it an enrollment exam for Ding Feng Lou? It only happens once every few years.

steps.name: Ding Feng Lou Chef
steps.text: If you're interested, we're televising it right here!

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: That contestant...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Blaze...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Isn't this a restaurant...? How come this room's set up like a study?

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: In its centuries of history, Ding Feng Lou has hosted countless reputed celebrities. We set aside this room to safekeep any pieces of calligraphy or painting gifted by them.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Delicacies, calligraphies, paintings... all are works of art that take years of practicing.
Blaze looks up and around. Hundreds upon thousands of silk threads hang from the ceiling, a wooden placard tied to each one, resembling a curtain.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: All of these are... names of dishes...

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: As you're no doubt aware, Ding Feng Lou is hiring chefs in the runup to the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. This calls for cooks who are not just culinarily skilled, but who grasp the significances behind the dishes they make.

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: Every dish here originates from a past Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. Pick one placard, and tell me the dish's history. That is today's second stage.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (From the FEASTS? How the hell should I know any of these?!)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Whatever, I've gotten this far—)
Blaze closes her eyes, and swipes one down. The neighboring placards clatter against each other, as if an endless windchime.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: 'Medley of Whites'?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Blaze barely knows how to cook anything. Passing the first stage was already a miracle.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: She spent basically her whole life in Victoria. How could she possibly know any of these stories...?

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: Blaze... I really wish I could help you...

steps.name: Uptight Examiner
steps.text: You have a time limit. Do you know the origin of this dish?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: About fifty years ago, give or take, Yan's Grand Preceptor presented the True Lung with a dish—the simplest, plainest, stewed radishes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But the special thing was, the radishes she used came from all over the land, and each one had a massively different flavor and texture.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But having been stewed for long enough, they absorbed enough broth and were all equally tasty.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I hear Yan's always put education first, but because the country's so big, and every city has wildly different circumstances anyway, the farther out you go, the harder it is for students to really achieve.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The Grand Preceptor was trying to tell the True Lung that every student, no matter their background, should have equal opportunity.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The True Lung took the Grand Preceptor's advice, advocated hard for educational reform, tore down any regional restrictions and brought equality to educational resources.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The next year, when Baizao Academy announced its successful applicants, students from remote regions made up more than a half of the thousand-plus that qualified.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: In the decades after that, the Tianshis buried in their Bureau's books, the students studying like hell in their academies, all of them thanked the Grand Preceptor for boldly advising...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That, if I'm not mistaken, is what Medley of Whites represents...
Blaze senses the spectators stop chattering.
She's not wrong. Everyone is nervously watching her right this moment.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: (How... did Blaze know that?)

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: (And why would the exam writer leave the name of this dish in there...?)

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: (You don't just mention her, not in front of everyone...)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did I, uh, say something wrong...?
Interesting.
The voice descends from a few meters above. Blaze stares up above her, but doesn't see anyone.
A foot lands on a stairstep plank with a dull thud, subdued yet powerful, the kind nobody could miss.
It approaches, closer and closer, until Blaze can finally make out who it is—a stern and solemn man, far older than her, alighting from his long stairwell.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: After so many years, I didn't think anyone would remember this.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Nice to meet you, um...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: The story you've told is far older than you. Girl, how come you know it?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, someone from my family told me it, a long long time ago.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: He said he was one of those students in poverty, all the way back then.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: To know the spring of your water... I imagine your relative was a grateful and righteous man.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: But as for you...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Just what motive brought you here?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I... well, I'm... here to compete, of course...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Seeing as you've made it here, I'll give you one chance.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Final stage. No frills, no fuss. Make me a 'dish'.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Come.
Too early for dinnertime, the restaurant is almost empty save for a couple of diners. There's no waiters, no proprietor, and even the kitchen is quiet.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Excuse me...

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: You, young man! Help me out!

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: I was in a hurry this morning and forgot my money. You're a well-to-do boy, anyone can tell! Be a kind man, spot me a little!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: I'm not here to rip you off. Here, take this family jade for now. Once I grab the money later, I'll pay you back.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Not that I mind lending you... but couldn't you just tell the owner instead...? We're total strangers—how would you find me and pay me back?

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: No, no, no, you see, this jade's not your average thing, it's not fit for just anyone to take. I'm only entrusting it to you because I can tell, you've got a rare air about you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A-Alright...
Zuo Le rummages for some loose coins in his pocket, and hands them to the diner, whose face immediately broadens with delight.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: When do you plan to pay me back...? Where would we meet?

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: We'll meet if we do and we won't if we don't. And if we don't, you can just go ahead and pawn this jade off.

steps.name: Penniless Diner
steps.text: Relax, relax. You've made a favorable deal today, young sir.
So saying, the diner is gone out the restaurant door in a blink, disappearing into the crowds.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Pawn... it off?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's my dish. Pretty good job, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...Longevity noodles?
Mo Bufu's hands rest on the table, chopsticks in his grasp. For a while, silence, before he finally picks up the spoon and tries a mouthful of soup.
Blaze examines Chef Mo's face closely, but the satisfied look she's hoping for simply does not blossom across the old man's face.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: These noodles... this soup base, who taught you this?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It was this tiny little chef. I really put my back into learning it, too...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: The owner of 'Savors at Yu's'. Who is he to you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How come you know...?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I thought so...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...The disgrace of him!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I see he has talent and give him the chance to display his skills. He's not grateful for that, fine. But now, now he even sends an amateur to humiliate me!

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: What's happening? Blaze finished it up with no trouble... nothing should be wrong with the flavor.

steps.name: Xingzhu
steps.text: ...Does Mo Bufu know the Young Chef somehow?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait! Okay, hold on!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm sorry! I know you can probably tell I suck at cooking at a glance, but I didn't come so I could wreck your competition!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I just have a question that only you can answer!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I grew up in Victoria, see, and this relative of mine who lived far away in Yan would always send me these tangerine cakes. They were so sweet and tasty...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I've been on the hunt ever since I came to Baizao, but I still haven't found that flavor...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I was thinking, since you're the best chef in all of Baizao, maybe you would know!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: A single pastry? You thought it was worth entering this competition to meet me, over a single pastry?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I have tons of other questions still! But this is the only one I can solve on my own. This is the one clue, the one link I have to my family!

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: ...The greatest taboo when making tangerine cakes is to blindly add sugar. That is, to mask the poorness of your craft and ingredients with sweetness.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: I don't know of anyone skilled enough to make tangerine cakes that are sweet and yet taste good on their own.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: You've asked your question. Now go.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait—
A muffled sound from above interrupts the two. Blaze and Mo Bufu look up at the same time, but both of their faces get struck by something wet.

steps.name: Mo Bufu
steps.text: Why is it leaking in here...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No... this is oil!
And the moment she says it, the lamp suspended from the dome ignites in a blink, becoming a fireball—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Get outta here!
